name: Pokédex
description: Browse a searchable batch of Pokémon and inspect artwork, types, abilities, and base stats.
template:
<Stack gap='sm'>
<Group justify='space-between' wrap='nowrap' gap='xs'><Stack gap={0} style={{ minWidth: 0 }}><Text fw={700} size='lg' truncate>Pokédex</Text><Text size='xs' c='dimmed'>Browse and inspect Pokémon</Text></Stack><RefreshButton requestId='list' /></Group>
{status.list?.loading ? <SimpleGrid minColWidth={140} autoFlow='auto-fit' spacing='sm'><Skeleton height={220} /><Skeleton height={220} /></SimpleGrid> : status.list?.ok === false ? <Alert color='red' title='Pokédex unavailable'>{status.list.statusText || status.list.error || 'The Pokémon list could not be loaded.'}</Alert> : (data.list?.results ?? []).length === 0 ? <Text size='sm' c='dimmed'>No Pokémon are available in this page.</Text> : <SimpleGrid minColWidth={140} autoFlow='auto-fit' spacing='sm'>
<Stack gap='xs' style={{ minWidth: 0 }}><Text fw={600}>Browse Pokémon</Text><TextInput bind='lookup' defaultValue='' label='Direct name lookup' placeholder='e.g. pikachu' clearable /><Select bind='selected' defaultValue='' label='Search loaded Pokémon' placeholder='Choose from this page' searchable clearable data={(data.list?.results ?? []).map(item => ({ value: item.name, label: item.name }))} /><Text size='xs' c='dimmed'>{(data.list?.results ?? []).length} Pokémon loaded · filter by name</Text>{(data.list?.results ?? []).filter(item => item.name.includes((inputs.lookup ?? '').trim().toLowerCase())).length === 0 ? <Text size='sm' c='dimmed'>No matches in this page. Direct name lookup still works.</Text> : <Stack gap={4}>{(data.list?.results ?? []).filter(item => item.name.includes((inputs.lookup ?? '').trim().toLowerCase())).map(item => <Group key={item.name} justify='space-between' wrap='nowrap' gap='xs'><Text size='sm' truncate>{item.name}</Text><Text size='xs' c='dimmed'>#{item.url.split('/').filter(Boolean).slice(-1)[0]}</Text></Group>)}</Stack>}</Stack>
<Stack gap='xs' style={{ minWidth: 0 }}><Text fw={600}>Pokémon details</Text>{inputs.lookup?.trim() || inputs.selected ? <SubFetch requestId='pokemon' trigger='manual' params={{ name: (inputs.lookup?.trim() ? inputs.lookup.trim() : inputs.selected).toLowerCase() }} triggerContent={<Text fw={600} c='teal'>Open {inputs.lookup?.trim() || inputs.selected}</Text>} triggerAriaLabel='Load Pokémon details'>{pokemon => <Stack gap='xs' style={{ minWidth: 0 }}><Group align='center' wrap='nowrap' gap='sm'>{pokemon.sprites?.other?.['official-artwork']?.front_default || pokemon.sprites?.front_default ? <Image src={pokemon.sprites?.other?.['official-artwork']?.front_default || pokemon.sprites?.front_default} alt={pokemon.name} h={112} fit='contain' /> : <Text size='sm' c='dimmed'>Artwork unavailable</Text>}<Stack gap={2} style={{ minWidth: 0 }}><Text fz={24} fw={700} c='teal' truncate>{pokemon.name}</Text><Text size='xs' c='dimmed'>#{pokemon.id ?? '—'}</Text><Text size='sm'>{pokemon.height == null ? '—' : (pokemon.height / 10).toLocaleString('en-US', { maximumFractionDigits: 1 })} m · {pokemon.weight == null ? '—' : (pokemon.weight / 10).toLocaleString('en-US', { maximumFractionDigits: 1 })} kg</Text></Stack></Group><Group gap='xs'>{(pokemon.types ?? []).map(entry => <Badge key={entry.slot} color={({ fire: 'orange', water: 'blue', grass: 'green', electric: 'yellow', psychic: 'grape', ice: 'cyan', dragon: 'violet', dark: 'dark', fairy: 'pink', fighting: 'red', poison: 'purple', ground: 'orange', flying: 'blue', bug: 'lime', rock: 'gray', ghost: 'grape', steel: 'gray', normal: 'gray' })[entry.type?.name] ?? 'gray'}>{entry.type?.name ?? 'Unknown'}</Badge>)}</Group><Stack gap='xs'><Group justify='space-between' wrap='nowrap' gap='xs'><Text fw={600} size='sm'>Base stats</Text><Group gap={4} align='baseline'><Text size='xs' c='dimmed'>Total</Text><Text fw={700} c='teal'>{(pokemon.stats ?? []).length > 0 && (pokemon.stats ?? []).every(stat => stat.base_stat !== undefined && stat.base_stat !== null) ? (pokemon.stats ?? []).reduce((total, stat) => total + stat.base_stat, 0) : '—'}</Text></Group></Group>{(pokemon.stats ?? []).map(stat => <Stack key={stat.stat?.name} gap={2}><Group justify='space-between' wrap='nowrap' gap='xs'><Text size='xs' c='dimmed' truncate>{(stat.stat?.name ?? 'Unknown').replace(/-/g, ' ')}</Text><Text size='xs' fw={600}>{stat.base_stat ?? '—'}</Text></Group>{stat.base_stat == null ? <Text size='xs' c='dimmed'>—</Text> : <Progress value={Math.min(stat.base_stat, 255) / 255 * 100} color='teal' size='sm' />}</Stack>)}</Stack><Stack gap={2}><Text fw={600} size='sm'>Abilities</Text><Text size='sm' style={{ overflowWrap: 'anywhere' }}>{(pokemon.abilities ?? []).map(entry => `${entry.ability?.name ?? 'Unknown'}${entry.is_hidden ? ' (hidden)' : ''}`).join(' · ') || '—'}</Text></Stack></Stack>}</SubFetch> : <Text size='sm' c='dimmed'>Type a name or choose a loaded Pokémon to see its details here.</Text>}</Stack>
</SimpleGrid>}
</Stack>
